source_record.prompt: Make a bounded wardrobe edit to the supplied accepted historical illustration. Preserve every recognizable face, apparent age, eye color, gaze, expression, facial anatomy, natural body fullness, hand and finger positions, action, composition, room and light. Do not slim Emma, change pregnancy/postpartum appearance, or replace anyone with a new actor. The supplied master-derived face is identity evidence, not an instruction to copy one later outfit into every year. Change only the specified clothes and arranged hair; preserve hair color and hairline exactly. Clothing is a researched period-plausible interpretation, not a claim the named people personally owned these precise garments. Natural photographic cloth and folds, no fashion-magazine styling, modern fasteners or modern hat. No text or new scene props. Preserve original input; this replacement does not add a second original count. January1827, Joseph21 and Emma22. Keep the warm plaid wool shawl and joined hands. Replace Emma's copied later blue dress and ornate brooch/lace collar with a muted warm-brown modest1820s day dress, raised waist, restrained full sleeves tapering at wrist, simple light neck covering, no ornate brooch. Retain her full natural figure. Arrange her same dark hair simply pinned at the back with restrained side curls, rather than identical long uniform ringlets. Joseph's winter coat becomes dark brown wool over a muted gray waistcoat and plain high-collared shirt; keep the natural white neckcloth, without copied1840s showpiece styling. No bridal white gown or invented wedding accessories.
source_record.source_limits: Period garment categories/forms only; exact individual colors, cloth, hairstyle and possession not documented. Garment references do not authorize body measurement claims.

normalization: Final placement id mapped to exact prompt/final bytes; source decision preserved, no new broader concurrence.
